text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I headed to the training track, a crowd had formed. Curious, I walked over to take a look—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Playing Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Come one, come all!
Thank you for waiting!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Playing Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Here comes the entrance of the representatives
for the Miho and Ritto dorms!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufufu♪ Ryan-oneesama, as much as you take care of me every day, I will be challenging you in full earnest~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, just what I wanted to hear.
I'm not going to hold back one bit either!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: Bright~, give it your all~!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: Ryan~, flex those muscles~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's an inter-dorm contest!
Every now and then, we split into Miho and Ritto like this to compete.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Even if it is just an exhibition, it is a chance to show Ryan-oneesama how much I have grown. I cannot afford to lose~.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Playing Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Now then, today's event is one of the
classic dormitory showdown matches: the "Trash Disposal Race"!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Playing Commentator
text_block_list.text: A mountain of trash bags stuffed with discarded materials and pulled weeds has been split evenly in two. Whoever finishes carrying their share to the disposal area first wins!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Playing Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Take your marks!
Ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haha, feeling great!
My biceps and triceps are loving this...! Alright, I can keep pushing!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Mejiro Ryan is utilizing her raw
muscle power to carry a mountain of garbage
at once! What blazing speed!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, how is Mejiro Bright
holding up—?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Phew, they certainly are hefty~.
I thought they looked quite adorable nestled together,
but goodness me...

text_block_list.name: Commentator Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
She appears to be struggling with the unexpected weight!
A clear gap has already started to open between them!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Hehe, looks like our Miho dorm takes this by a landslide.

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Hauling heavy loads is pretty much
Ryan-san's specialty, after all~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Phew... All right, halfway done!
I've pulled way ahead of Bright...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Still, I can't let my guard down.
I've seen firsthand how unshakably strong
Bright's spirit truly is—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Sure, she's always a bit more laid-back
and slower than everyone else, but—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(No matter how far behind she falls,
she always comes charging back in the end—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I won't let up for a second!
I'm going to win this match fair and square!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! *pant*, *pant*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't Ryan's pace
slowing down...?

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
You're right...
What in the world is happening...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sprinting while carrying heavy cargo—
pushing through what was essentially anaerobic exhaustion,
Mejiro Ryan was visibly running out of steam.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the other hand, Bright—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho, heave-ho.
Phew, I think I'm finally getting
the hang of my body's rhythm~.

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Bright hasn't slowed down her pace one bit
since the very start...! This is still anyone's game!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(Without being swayed by my surroundings,
slowly, steadily—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(Doing what I can,
step by step at my own pace.
If I do that—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(A path will surely open. The flower bud will bloom.
I can catch up to everyone ahead,
and overtake them—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(Believing that with all my heart is how I've lived.
So—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ryan-oneesama,
the real showdown begins now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on!
I'm not losing to you, Bright... ngh!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! They've grabbed their final bags
at almost the exact same time!
Who will be the first to sprint back to the finish line—?!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: Go, go, Ryaaaan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOAAAH—!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: Bright~! Don't give uuup~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeeeyah—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Commentator Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
By the slimmest of margins—
Ryan crosses the line first!
The winner of this contest is the Miho Dormitory!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Phew... I pulled it off...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Just one step short, was it?
Though I put up a good fight against
Ryan-oneesama...

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: Congrats, Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
Bright, great work!
You looked so cool out there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The spectators showered generous applause upon both runners
for putting on such a breathtakingly close battle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Such robust muscular strength and sharp movement.
Truly magnificent as expected of Ryan-oneesama.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That is the fruit of your relentless daily training, isn't it?
I must express my deepest admiration once again~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Haha, right back at you, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I knew for sure you'd catch up in the end,
but man, I never imagined you'd push me that hard!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I may have conceded victory to you this time, oneesama,
but I fully intend to turn the tables next time—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Which means I must master the art
of taking out the trash even further~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I know. I shall start by hauling
all the garbage from the Ritto dormitory.
Time for some immediate special training~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, right now...?! Seriously!?
You're something else, Bright...
